## Professional focus

Systems Administrator | Windows Infrastructure, Troubleshooting & Automation based in Rochester, NY. Seeking a permanent Level II or III Systems Administrator role; open to local, hybrid, or remote work.

Systems administrator focused on root-cause troubleshooting across Windows Server, Active Directory and Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, Hyper-V, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, RMM, and monitoring. I keep digging when an issue crosses systems or keeps coming back. Once I find the cause, I document the fix in runbooks or knowledge-base articles and train other technicians so the team can handle it next time. I also build and own internal tools, including the production ticketing system that fully replaced the legacy Perl/PHP workflow.

## Core capabilities

Windows Infrastructure: Windows Server administration, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS and DHCP, Windows Server patching, File shares and permissions, Backups and restores
Virtualization & Endpoint Operations: Hyper-V administration, Microsoft Intune, RMM administration, Infrastructure monitoring, Endpoint imaging and deployment, NAS administration, Server and storage hardware

Automation & Documentation: PowerShell, Batch, Python, JavaScript, Microsoft SQL Server, Runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge-base articles, Diagnostic tooling

## Selected case studies

Custom Ticketing & POS Operations System
Problem: The legacy Perl/PHP system still supported the repair workflow but had become impossible to update or repair and still ran as an IIS application on Windows Server 2008.
Environment: Legacy Perl/PHP application on IIS and Windows Server 2008, existing POS workflow, Microsoft SQL Server
Actions: Designed, built, and deployed the application without adapting a commercial or open-source ticketing base; preserved full backward compatibility; continue to administer authentication, backups, updates, bug fixes, and new features.
Result: Fully replaced and retired the legacy Perl/PHP ticketing workflow and its Windows Server 2008/IIS dependency while keeping all existing data usable in the new system.
Technologies: Python, JavaScript, Microsoft SQL Server, POS Integration, Legacy System Replacement

RMM Communication Failure Investigation
Problem: RMM check-ins were failing, which blocked patch management and managed antivirus functions.
Environment: Microworx customer environment, Windows endpoints, RMM, patch management, managed antivirus, TCP/IP
Actions: Wrote targeted diagnostic scripts and traced the failure to a rogue RAID-monitoring process flooding TCP traffic.
Result: Identified the hidden software conflict behind a failure that initially presented as an RMM communication problem.
Technologies: Diagnostic Scripting, RMM, Windows Endpoints, TCP/IP, Monitoring

VSS Live-Imaging Workflow
Problem: The existing imaging process slowed endpoint deployment and could carry operating-system corruption into the replacement system.
Environment: Windows endpoint deployment, live systems, Volume Shadow Copy Service
Actions: Developed an in-house VSS live-imaging and delta-merging workflow that restored programs and data onto a fresh Windows installation.
Result: Improved deployment stability by avoiding corruption carried forward from the previous Windows installation.
Evidence: Built a VSS live-imaging and delta-merging workflow that cut endpoint deployment time by 40% on average while restoring programs and data onto a fresh Windows installation instead of carrying forward corruption from the previous OS.
Technologies: VSS, Windows Deployment, Endpoint Imaging

NewComputerSetup
Problem: New-computer setup required repetitive manual configuration in client environments where PXE was not always available.
Environment: Windows workstations, MSP client standards, non-PXE deployment environments
Actions: Built a customizable Batch workflow that applied the required software, settings, naming, upgrade, and handoff steps consistently.
Result: Made workstation deployment faster and more consistent across MSP clients.
Evidence: Reduced manual workstation setup time by 75% through Batch deployment automation.
Technologies: Batch, Windows Deployment, Endpoint Administration
Repository: https://github.com/Jessomadic/NewComputerSetup/tree/Main

It fully replaced and retired the legacy Perl/PHP ticketing workflow. That aging IIS application on Windows Server 2008 was impossible to update or repair; the replacement preserved full backward compatibility, so all existing data remained usable in the new system.
